testcase.name: Disconnect is idempotent finishes existing and late collectors and rejects closed injection()
Failure threshold is based on successful sends and remains armed()
OK and error simulation use pinned codes optional fields and UInt32 little endian()
Cancelled collection does not close the connection or discard future input()
Reconnect uses a fresh stream without leaking old queued packets or losing send history()
Mock begins disconnected with an empty history and opt-in capabilities()
Collectors share a single ingestion queue rather than broadcasting or conflating ACKs()
Failure threshold preserves source signed Int behavior and large indices()
Raw input can be buffered before connect and retains repeated empty and unknown packets()
Precancelled commands do not mutate history state or input()
Capability setter controls both write commands and pipelined reads()
Both send paths require a connection and append exact immutable payloads()
